notes: A short list of proven single skills. Every entry is one skill folder on GitHub with real use (install counts or stars) or a builder with a record, useful to a normal AI user, and checked for malicious code (piped-shell installs, credential reads, obfuscated code) in the files it installs; re-checked whenever those files change. `checked.date` is the latest scan. Provided as-is - read anything before you run it.
